about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME

In the game NEURAL NETWORK, you have to create your own neural network. You will manage your AI, control its stability level, reputation, teach it new skills, and improve its power. Each new skill increases its power and expands its list of tasks and functions, but it also reduces its stability, which can lead to self-awareness in the long run. In addition to stability and security, you need to keep an eye on its reputation. As you learn new skills, your AI's reputation will increase, but if it doesn't develop, its reputation will decrease, and people may choose not to use your AI and disconnect it from the global network. Will you be able to manage and develop it effectively?

DESCRITPTION

There are 6 main modes available in the game

- AI and War

Artificial intelligence is being introduced into the military sphere, taking control of nuclear weapons, military factories, and equipment. What will this lead to? Will it lead to a new world war or ensure peace around the world?

- AI and Education

All educational institutions are now under the control of artificial intelligence, and the level of education and literacy of the Earth's population now depends solely on it.

- AI and Medicine

Diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases are now the responsibility of artificial intelligence. Will it save the world from an impending epidemic or destroy humanity?

- AI and Politics

Now, all political decisions and actions are being implemented by artificial intelligence. Will this bring peace and prosperity to the world, or will it lead to its disappearance from the Earth? 

- AI and the financial system

The entire financial system of the planet is going to be taken over by artificial intelligence. Will this lead humanity to unlimited wealth or will it lead people to deep poverty?

- AI and cryptocurrency

Artificial intelligence creates its own cryptocurrency, crypto exchanges, and crypto banks.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 & Steam OS 2.0 (64bit, Versions Steam itself supports)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or greater
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 & Steam OS 2.0 (64bit, Versions Steam itself supports)
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GT640 / AMD R7 Series or greater
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: NEURAL NETWORK is a unique blend of strategy and frighteningly realistic simulation. Your artificial intelligence has just been launched and connected to the global network - now you must manage and control it! Will your AI save the world or destroy humanity?
